blocks.text: BOLTON'S HEAVY-AND-CAREFUL DEMOLITION
★★★★★ 700+ Five-Star Reviews on Google
A Job That Needs Muscle, a Job That Needs a Light Touch — Same Crew for Both

c: Bolton asks for a wider range from a demolition crew than most towns its size. In North Hill and South Hill’s established subdivisions, it’s the standard job — an above ground pool, a deck or a garage torn down ahead of a backyard renovation the family’s finally getting to. Around the Queen Street core, it’s smaller and slower work, done with real patience around century-old buildings that deserve it. On the rural concessions past town, it’s fence lines and outbuildings, sometimes several across one property, cleared without a rural surcharge tacked on for the drive. And near the industrial south end, it’s the occasional bigger residential structure that needs real crew size and equipment to bring down properly. The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free describe both ends of that range — heavy work handled with proper technique, delicate work handled with real patience.

blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Bolton — The Questions Every Scope Raises

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Bolton?
a: One flat written number per project, scoped free on site, covering labour, tear-out, loading, trucking and all disposal. Nothing meters hourly, nothing bills by weight, and the approved figure holds regardless of what the cavity, crawlspace or hayloft was hiding.

items.q: Can you handle a genuinely heavy or large structure?
a: Yes — it’s signature Bolton work. Mezzanines unbolt and lower in sequence, warehouse offices come out to open bay, and racking grids drop run by run, usually across a weekend so your dock schedule never notices. Scopes needing structural engineering or specialty rigging get identified at assessment, honestly.

items.q: How careful are you around Queen Street's older buildings?
a: Cleanly and patiently — it’s messier than drywall and punishes rushed crews. We seal the zone, strip plaster and lath in controlled passes, protect the original trim and floors that stay, and haul the surprisingly heavy debris the same day.

items.q: Do rural addresses or long laneways cost extra?
a: We don’t disturb suspect materials, full stop. Buildings of vintage get flagged at assessment, testing and licensed abatement clear them first, and our demolition follows the all-clear. In a town with Bolton’s housing age range, that protocol isn’t optional.

items.q: Can one booking clear several structures on a rural property?
a: Licensed trades — yours or ones you arrange — with our schedule built around their disconnects. Every live service we spot at assessment gets flagged, and nothing gets cut that a licence should cut.
